description: Redesign the entire dashboard with glassmorphism: sidebar, top bar, stats cards, filter bar, regulation cards, and main page. All components get glass treatment with emerald accents.
steps: Rewrite app/dashboard/layout.tsx: Background bg-gray-950. Sidebar: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border-r border-white/10. Logo: emerald gradient text. Nav items: inactive = text-gray-400 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white; active = bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-l-2 border-emerald-400 or similar indicator. Sign out button: text-gray-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5. Top bar: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. Mobile overlay: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm. User avatar circle: bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400. Remove all light mode classes.

Rewrite components/dashboard/ComplianceStats.tsx: Stats cards use glass styling: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl. Label text: text-gray-400. Value text: text-white font-bold. For the main value numbers, add bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 to-teal-400 bg-clip-text text-transparent for a gradient number effect (except critical alerts which stays red). Remove all light/dark mode conditional classes.

Rewrite components/dashboard/FilterBar.tsx: Search input and select dropdowns use glass styling: bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-white placeholder:text-gray-500 focus:border-emerald-500 focus:ring-emerald-500/20. Search icon text-gray-500. Select options may need bg-gray-900 for the dropdown menu (browser native selects). Remove all light mode classes.

Rewrite components/dashboard/RegulationCard.tsx: Card container: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 hover:border-emerald-500/30 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-emerald-500/5 transition-all duration-200. Add a left border color accent based on severity: border-l-2 with border-l-red-500 for CRITICAL, border-l-amber-500 for WARNING, border-l-emerald-500 for INFO. Title text-white. Summary text-gray-400. Date text-gray-500. Keep Link wrapper and all existing props/logic.

Update app/dashboard/page.tsx: Update heading text-white. Loading skeleton: bg-white/5 rounded-2xl animate-pulse. Empty state text: text-gray-400. Error box: bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 text-red-400. Onboarding CTA: button should use emerald gradient (already handled by Button component). Remove all light mode conditional classes (dark: prefixes where the dark version is now the only version).
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard sidebar uses glass styling with emerald active indicators
Top bar uses glass styling with border-bottom
Stats cards are glassmorphic with emerald gradient numbers
Filter bar inputs use glass styling with emerald focus states
Regulation cards have glass bg with severity-colored left border
Regulation cards have hover glow effect
Dashboard page skeleton loaders use glass styling
No light mode classes remain in any dashboard file
All existing functionality (filtering, API calls, navigation) remains intact
npm run build succeeds without errors
verification: Run npm run build in /projects/sandbox/notherobrinesmplol and confirm exit code 0
